settings.heading: Crafted in our own workshop.
settings.lead: Design, build, finish and test, under one roof. Shown, never shouted.

settings.heading: Every piece starts in CAD.
settings.text: Each cap is drawn to the millimetre for its hub. Fit is designed before anything is cut.

settings.heading: Built in-house, in small runs.
settings.text: Small runs keep every set close to the bench, and keep the drop rare.

settings.heading: Every edge checked by hand.
settings.text: Shells are finished, bearings seated and plates set by hand. The detail is the product.

settings.heading: Real heat, real roads, real use.
settings.text: Tested moving, not just standing still.

settings.heading: Parked in August. Driven the same day.
settings.text: Caps sit on dark wheels under the midday sun, then go straight onto the road. Then we check every one.

settings.heading: The build, from CAD to the road
